consent.title: Consent for your child's data
consent.subtitle: Please read this once. You can ask the school to withdraw it at any time.
consent.p1: {school} uses this app to manage your child's school records: name, class, date of birth, attendance, fees, timetable and notices, along with your name and mobile number.
consent.p2: This information is used only to run the school and keep you informed. It is not sold or used for advertising.
consent.p3: It is visible only to school staff who need it for their work, and to you as the parent or guardian.
consent.p4: The data is stored in India and kept for as long as your child studies here and the law requires.
consent.p5: Under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 you can ask the school to see, correct or erase this data, or withdraw this consent, by contacting the school office.
consent.agreeLabel: I am the parent or lawful guardian and I give consent as described above.
consent.changed: The consent text was updated. Please read it again.

setup.bannerBody: Add the academic year, classes, sections and subjects so teachers and parents can start using the app.
setup.title: School setup
setup.subtitle: A few short steps. You can come back and change anything later.

help.profile: Check your school's name and board, and choose the words the app uses for classes and sections.
help.academicYear: The academic year that is running now. Attendance, fees and timetables belong to a year.
help.levels: Create the classes your school teaches. Most schools need 1 to 12.
help.sections: Create the sections (divisions) of each class for this academic year.
help.subjects: Pick the subjects your school teaches. You can add more later.
help.finish: Review the steps and finish. Next, assign subjects and teachers to each section.

setup.levelsMore: Need other {level} names (e.g. Nursery, LKG)? Add them later on the Classes page.

setup.sectionNamesHint: Separate with commas, e.g. A, B, C
setup.nextSteps: Next: open each {level} and {section} to set its subjects, teachers and class teacher.

imports.description: Add many students or staff at once from a CSV file. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
imports.step1: Download the template and fill one row per person.
imports.step2: Choose the file and check it. You will see every problem with its row number.
imports.step3: Import. New logins get temporary passwords, shown once.
imports.excelHint: Using Excel? Choose File → Save As → "CSV UTF-8 (Comma delimited)". Dates can be DD-MM-YYYY. Up to 2,000 rows per file.
imports.tooLarge: The file is larger than 1 MB. Split it into smaller files.
imports.intoYear: Students will be placed in academic year {year}.
imports.skipInvalid: Skip the {count} rows with errors and import the rest
imports.allOrNothing: The import is all or nothing: if anything fails, nothing is saved.
imports.importing: Importing… this can take up to a minute
